title: A set logged from the watch while the app is closed can be dropped without a word
what: When the phone queued 'Done' taps while MettleUp was closed and one of them lacks a number, the app takes the tap off the queue but, if it is not on screen at that moment, neither saves it nor leaves the 'Open MettleUp to log' note the other Done path leaves. The member believes the set was logged.
expected: A queued tap that cannot be saved stays queued, or leaves the same note as a live Done tap.
how_often: rarely: a watch Done with a missing number, read while the app is in the background
fix_line: Leave the same note as a live Done, or keep the tap queued

title: Help still tells members to tap a card that was removed

The article has no not-released mark, so it still shows.
expected: The article is hidden (marked not released) while the card is off.
how_often: every member who opens that help article
